```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(mSigAct)
library(patchwork)
```

## Run mSigAct on clonal and nonclonal
```{r}
# load reference signatures (COSMIC v3.6)
ref.sigs <- ICAMS::ReadCatalog("/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/COSMIC_Human_SBS-96_GRCh38_v3.6.tsv")
ref.sigs <- ICAMS::as.catalog(ref.sigs,
                              ref.genome = "GRCh38",
                              region = "genome",
                              catalog.type = "counts.signature")

# The Duplex Sequencing only targets a small part of the human genome
# calculate the trinucleotide composition of the DS target region
# and adjust the reference signatures to take this difference into account
DS.target.BED<-ICAMS:::ReadBedRanges("/mnt/storage/peter/steve_aa/AA_normal_blood_tumors_DS_WGS_singleCells_SteveRozen_Arnoud/TwinstrandDraft/Supplementary/Supplemental_code/input/Twinstrand.bed")
DS_abundance<-ICAMS:::GetCustomKmerCounts(k = 3,
                                          ref.genome = "GRCh38",
                                          custom.ranges = DS.target.BED)
DS_abundance<-ICAMS:::Collapse192AbundanceTo96(DS_abundance[,1])
ref.sigs.DS<-ICAMS::TransformCatalog(ref.sigs,
                                     target.ref.genome = NULL,
                                     target.region = "unknown",
                                     target.catalog.type = "counts.signature",
                                     target.abundance = DS_abundance)

prior.sigs <- c("SBS1", "SBS5", "SBS22a", "SBS39", "SBS40a", "SBS100", "SBS31") ## SBS31 added because UC14 was treated with cisplatin

input_file <- "/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/matGen/ds_filtered_clonal/output/SBS/UC_AA.SBS96.all"
input_catalog <- ICAMS::ReadCatalog(file = input_file)

sparseAssign <- SparseAssignActivity(spectra = input_catalog,
                                     sigs = ref.sigs.DS[,prior.sigs],
                                     max.level = length(prior.sigs)-1,
                                     p.thresh = 0.05/length(prior.sigs),
                                     num.parallel.samples = 5,
                                     mc.cores.per.sample = 20,
                                     drop.low.mut.samples = FALSE,
                                     seed = 425,
                                     output.dir = "/mnt/storage/peter/repo/manuAA/data/mSigAct/dsnogermlineClonal_uc_cosmic_arnoud")
# save(sparseAssign, file = "/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/mSigAct/dsnogermlineClonal_uc_cosmic_arnoud.rda")

prior.sigs <- c("SBS1", "SBS5", "SBS22a", "SBS39", "SBS40a", "SBS100")

sparseAssign <- SparseAssignActivity(spectra = input_catalog,
                                     sigs = ref.sigs.DS[,prior.sigs],
                                     max.level = length(prior.sigs)-1,
                                     p.thresh = 0.05/length(prior.sigs),
                                     num.parallel.samples = 5,
                                     mc.cores.per.sample = 20,
                                     drop.low.mut.samples = FALSE,
                                     seed = 425,
                                     output.dir = "/mnt/storage/peter/repo/manuAA/data/mSigAct/dsnogermlineClonal_uc_cosmic_arnoud_noSBS31")
# save(sparseAssign, file = "/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/mSigAct/dsnogermlineClonal_uc_cosmic_arnoud_noSBS31.rda")

input_file <- "/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/matGen/ds_filtered_nonclonal/output/SBS/UC_AA.SBS96.all"
input_catalog <- ICAMS::ReadCatalog(file = input_file)

prior.sigs <- c("SBS1", "SBS5", "SBS22a", "SBS39", "SBS40a", "SBS100", "SBS31")

sparseAssign <- SparseAssignActivity(spectra = input_catalog,
                                     sigs = ref.sigs.DS[,prior.sigs],
                                     max.level = length(prior.sigs)-1,
                                     p.thresh = 0.05/length(prior.sigs),
                                     num.parallel.samples = 5,
                                     mc.cores.per.sample = 20,
                                     drop.low.mut.samples = FALSE,
                                     seed = 425,
                                     output.dir = "/mnt/storage/peter/repo/manuAA/data/mSigAct/dsnogermlineNonClonal_uc_cosmic_arnoud")
# save(sparseAssign, file = "/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/mSigAct/dsnogermlineNonClonal_uc_cosmic_arnoud.rda")

prior.sigs <- c("SBS1", "SBS5", "SBS22a", "SBS39", "SBS40a", "SBS100")

sparseAssign <- SparseAssignActivity(spectra = input_catalog,
                                     sigs = ref.sigs.DS[,prior.sigs],
                                     max.level = length(prior.sigs)-1,
                                     p.thresh = 0.05/length(prior.sigs),
                                     num.parallel.samples = 5,
                                     mc.cores.per.sample = 20,
                                     drop.low.mut.samples = FALSE,
                                     seed = 425,
                                     output.dir = "/mnt/storage/peter/repo/manuAA/data/mSigAct/dsnogermlineNonClonal_uc_cosmic_arnoud_noSBS31")
```

Panel A (left) comparing Clonal vs Nonclonal for SBS22a attribution
```{r}
## Clonal signature attribution res with mSigAct (Filter for UC14 samples)
load("/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/mSigAct/dsnogermlineClonal_uc_cosmic_arnoud.rda")
## Clonal tmb per sample
assignment_tmb_clonal <- sparseAssign$proposed.assignment %>% t() %>% as.data.frame()
## Signature attribution per sample
assignment_res_clonal <- sparseAssign$proposed.assignment %>% t() %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  sweep(1, rowSums(.), "/") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(.x < 0.05, 0, .x))) %>%
  sweep(1, rowSums(.), "/") %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Samples") %>%
  dplyr::filter(grepl(pattern = "UC14", x = Samples))

## Clonal without SBS31 in the universe (Remove UC14 samples)
load("/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/mSigAct/dsnogermlineClonal_uc_cosmic_arnoud_noSBS31.rda")
assignment_res_clonal2 <- sparseAssign$proposed.assignment %>% t() %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  sweep(1, rowSums(.), "/") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(.x < 0.05, 0, .x))) %>%
  sweep(1, rowSums(.), "/") %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Samples") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!grepl(pattern = "UC14", x = Samples)) %>%
  mutate(SBS31 = 0)

## Combine the two df together
assignment_res_clonal <- rbind(assignment_res_clonal, assignment_res_clonal2)

## Do the same thing for NonClonal
load("/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/mSigAct/dsnogermlineNonClonal_uc_cosmic_arnoud.rda")

assignment_tmb_nonclonal <- sparseAssign$proposed.assignment %>% t() %>% as.data.frame()

assignment_res_nonclonal <- sparseAssign$proposed.assignment %>% t() %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  sweep(1, rowSums(.), "/") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(.x < 0.05, 0, .x))) %>%
  sweep(1, rowSums(.), "/") %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Samples") %>%
  dplyr::filter(grepl(pattern = "UC14", x = Samples))

load("/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/mSigAct/dsnogermlineNonClonal_uc_cosmic_arnoud_noSBS31.rda")

assignment_res_nonclonal2 <- sparseAssign$proposed.assignment %>% t() %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  sweep(1, rowSums(.), "/") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(.x < 0.05, 0, .x))) %>%
  sweep(1, rowSums(.), "/") %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Samples") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!grepl(pattern = "UC14", x = Samples)) %>%
  mutate(SBS31 = 0)

assignment_res_nonclonal <- rbind(assignment_res_nonclonal, assignment_res_nonclonal2)

## Subset for SBS22a attribution and rename based on if its clonal or nonclonal
ds_nonclonal <- assignment_res_nonclonal %>% dplyr::select(Samples, SBS22a) %>%
  dplyr::rename("NonClonal" = "SBS22a")

ds_clonal <- assignment_res_clonal %>% dplyr::select(Samples,SBS22a) %>%
  dplyr::rename("Clonal" = "SBS22a")

## Combine the data together
combined_all_clonal <- ds_nonclonal %>% left_join(x = ., y = ds_clonal, by = "Samples") %>%
  dplyr::filter(NonClonal > 0) %>%
  dplyr::select(Samples, Clonal, NonClonal) %>%
  gather(data = ., key = "Mutation", value = "value", -Samples) %>%
  mutate(type = case_when(grepl(pattern = "N", x = Samples) ~ "N",
                          grepl(pattern = "T", x = Samples) ~ "T",
                          grepl(pattern = "Blood", x = Samples) ~ "B",
                          grepl(pattern = "Urine", x = Samples) ~ "U"),
         group = paste0("UC", as.numeric(str_extract(Samples, "\\d+"))))

## Factor order
combined_all_clonal$Mutation <- factor(x = combined_all_clonal$Mutation, levels = c("NonClonal", "Clonal"))
combined_all_clonal$type <- factor(x = combined_all_clonal$type, levels = c("T", "N","B", "U"))

## Color annotation
color_anno <- c("#A6A6A6", "#4F81BD", "#D7191C", "#FDAE61")
names(color_anno) <- c("N", "T", "B", "U")

##############
## plotting ##

## Clonal and SBS22a attribution
p10 <- ggplot(data = combined_all_clonal %>% dplyr::filter(Mutation == "Clonal"), aes(x = type, y = value)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.5, aes(fill = type)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 0.5, color = "black", shape = 21) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.05, 1.05),
                     breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25)) +
  ylab("SBS22a Attribution") + ggtitle("Clonal") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_anno) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b=0)),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin(0,5,0,0),
        legend.position = "none")

## NonClonal and SBS22a attribution
p100 <- ggplot(data = combined_all_clonal %>% dplyr::filter(Mutation == "NonClonal"), aes(x = type, y = value)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.5, aes(fill = type)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 0.5, color = "black", shape = 21) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.05, 1.05),
                     breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25)) +
  ylab("SBS22a Attribution") + ggtitle("NonClonal") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_anno) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b=0)),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin(0,5,0,0),
        legend.position = "none")

## Correlation analysis

## Nonclonal
combined_all_clonal$type_num <- as.numeric(combined_all_clonal$type)

df <- combined_all_clonal %>% dplyr::filter(Mutation == "NonClonal")

cor.test(
  df$type_num,
  df$value,
  method = "spearman"
)

## rho -0.1501002 p-value = 0.5522

## Clonal
df <- combined_all_clonal %>% dplyr::filter(Mutation == "Clonal")

cor.test(
  df$type_num,
  df$value,
  method = "spearman"
)

# rho -0.8036692 p-value = 5.872e-05
```

Panel A (right) comparing Clonal vs Nonclonal for aging attribution (SBS1 and SBS5)
```{r}
## Same coding like the previous chunk
ds_nonclonal <- assignment_res_nonclonal %>% mutate(NonClonal = SBS1 + SBS5) %>%
  dplyr::select(Samples, NonClonal)

ds_clonal <- assignment_res_clonal %>% mutate(Clonal = SBS1 + SBS5) %>%
  dplyr::select(Samples, Clonal)

combined_all_clonal <- ds_nonclonal %>% left_join(x = ., y = ds_clonal, by = "Samples") %>%
  dplyr::filter(NonClonal > 0) %>%
  dplyr::select(Samples, Clonal, NonClonal) %>%
  gather(data = ., key = "Mutation", value = "value", -Samples) %>%
  mutate(type = case_when(grepl(pattern = "N", x = Samples) ~ "N",
                          grepl(pattern = "T", x = Samples) ~ "T",
                          grepl(pattern = "Blood", x = Samples) ~ "B",
                          grepl(pattern = "Urine", x = Samples) ~ "U"),
         group = paste0("UC", as.numeric(str_extract(Samples, "\\d+"))))

combined_all_clonal$Mutation <- factor(x = combined_all_clonal$Mutation, levels = c("NonClonal", "Clonal"))
combined_all_clonal$type <- factor(x = combined_all_clonal$type, levels = c("T", "N","B", "U"))

p11 <- ggplot(data = combined_all_clonal %>% dplyr::filter(Mutation == "Clonal"), aes(x = type, y = value)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.5, aes(fill = type)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 0.5, color = "black", shape = 21) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.05, 1.05),
                     breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25)) +
  ylab("Aging Attribution") + ggtitle("Clonal") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_anno) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b=0)),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin(0,5,0,0),
        legend.position = "none")

p110 <- ggplot(data = combined_all_clonal %>% dplyr::filter(Mutation == "NonClonal"), aes(x = type, y = value)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.5, aes(fill = type)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 0.5, color = "black", shape = 21) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.05, 1.05),
                     breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25)) +
  ylab("Aging Attribution") + ggtitle("NonClonal") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_anno) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b=0)),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin(0,5,0,0),
        legend.position = "none")

## Combine all figures together into a panel
combined_plot_boxplot <- (p100 + p10 + p110 + p11) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1,1,1,1))

## Correlation analysis with aging
combined_all_clonal$type_num <- as.numeric(combined_all_clonal$type)

## Nonclonal
df <- combined_all_clonal %>% dplyr::filter(Mutation == "NonClonal")

cor.test(
  df$type_num,
  df$value,
  method = "spearman"
)

## rho 0.3053072 p-value = 0.1378

## Clonal
df <- combined_all_clonal %>% dplyr::filter(Mutation == "Clonal")

cor.test(
  df$type_num,
  df$value,
  method = "spearman"
)

# rho 0.3627764 p-value = 0.0747
```


Panel B - Comparing SBS attribution nonclonal vs clonal
```{r}
assignment_res_clonal_long <- assignment_res_clonal %>% gather(data = ., key = "signatures", value = "value", -Samples) %>%
  mutate(method = "C")
assignment_res_nonclonal_long <- assignment_res_nonclonal %>% gather(data = ., key = "signatures", value = "value", -Samples) %>%
  mutate(method = "NC")

combined_res <- rbind(assignment_res_nonclonal_long, assignment_res_clonal_long) %>% #, assignment_res_nonclonal
  mutate(group = paste0("UC", as.numeric(str_extract(Samples, "\\d+"))))

sample.order <- c("UC2", "UC4", "UC5", "UC7", "UC10", "UC11", "UC13", "UC14", "UC18", "UC19", "UC26", "UC34")

## Factor level

combined_res$method <- factor(x = combined_res$method, levels = c("NC", "C"))
combined_res$signatures <- factor(x = combined_res$signatures, 
                                levels = c("SBS1",  "SBS5", "SBS22a", "SBS31", "SBS39", "SBS40a", "SBS100"))

sbs.color2 <- c("#5A5A5A", "#9E9E9E", "#A020F0", "#E6AB02", "#7A7A7A", "#1B9E77", "#C26D3D")

        legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"),
        ) 

library(cowplot)
p9_legend <- get_legend(p9_legend)

legend_row1 <- plot_grid(
  p9_legend) + theme(plot.margin = margin(5, 0, 0, 0))
```
